name: Palm Readers
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of consulting palm readers and those with familiar spirits, warning God’s people to avoid such occult practices. The Old Testament commands believers not to seek out wizards, witches, or those who use divination, emphasizing that doing so defiles them and brings God’s judgment, including severe consequences such as being cut off from the community or even death. Instead, Isaiah 8:19 calls God’s people to seek the Lord rather than turning to the dead or occult sources for guidance, affirming that true wisdom and direction come only from God.
